title: Pael's Flesh
description: Gain an additional 1 Energy at the start of your [blue]3rd[/blue] turn, and every turn after that.
flavor: [red]Details for this relic will be revealed in the future...[/red]
notes: The relic displays the current turn number as a counter during combat. It becomes Active (glows) when the 3rd turn begins and returns to Normal status after combat ends.
